text: Text reference: properties (font/style tokens, valign, font_size tokens, weight, italic as a metrics change, truncate, span), typography v1 (case, decoration, ellipsis, paragraph spacing), rich-text spans, no synthetic italics, overflow patterns.
font($type.x) / style($type.x) are preferred when branded; font_size($type.size.x) token form preferred over raw numbers.
Pair case(upper) with wide tracking(...) for an eyebrow/kicker — never on body copy (see knowledge/design/typography-and-composition).
note: BROKEN REFERENCE: typography-and-composition.md is legacy-only, not in the scene view.

text: Rules of thumb (canvas-independent): one element dominates per artifact; the hero is ~2–3× body; a stat/secondary value must read visibly smaller than the hero … step the headline to 64–80 on a big canvas. See knowledge/design/foundations.
note: Numeric rules of thumb that components.md says not to use ("No fixed width, line count, type ratio … follows"). BROKEN REFERENCE: foundations.md is legacy-only.

text: Patterns that fit: headline/body/cta_text examples, including cta_text "Book a Demo".
note: The only CTA example says "Book a Demo"; scene-brief-copy says "Do not default every creative to a pill or to 'Book a demo'".

text: A headline or label placed over a photo must sit on a scrim and use an inverse fill … Declaration order is image → scrim → text. See the scrim idiom in grammar.md and knowledge/images/placement; legibility-over-image is a hard imagery-critic gate.
note: CONFLICT: image-grammar.md (spliced into grammar.md in place of the scrim idiom) says "no scrim or fixed frame pattern is compulsory". BROKEN REFERENCES: the grammar scrim idiom is removed by the section override; knowledge/images/placement is legacy-only; "imagery-critic gate" is a trio-era reviewer.

text: The fix is small and targeted: widen/heighten the box, raise max_lines, drop the font a point, or switch the slot's overflow policy. Do not redesign the whole scene to fix one box — see skills/repair-design.
